text:
nora: Quick design thread: thinking about combining 'Copy ID' and 'Copy permalink' into a single compact control in the trace detail. Instead of separate buttons, a small chevron reveals two options: "Copy ID" and "Copy permalink (short)". Thoughts? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/permix-ux

ashe: I like compactness but worried about discoverability. Many folks want the raw ID for logs, others want a short permalink for sharing. If we combine, make the primary action configurable or show the last-used action as default.

devon: From analytics POV, capture which sub-action used. Events: trace.copy_method (props: method:full_id|permalink|shortcut, view:detail|list). Also, do not send full IDs in telemetry  mask them (last 6 chars) or hash server-side.

mika: Accessibility notes: the split control must be keyboard operable and screen-reader friendly. Use a visible trigger button with aria-haspopup and a menu with role=menu + role=menuitem for each option. For SRs announce when permalink copied: "Permalink copied".

nora: UX question: permalink format. Short link vs full deep link? Shorter is nicer in chat apps. We could generate a short token server-side, but private deployments may not allow external shorteners. Fallback: copy a long internal deep link when shortener isn't available.

ashe: Important: for Private/VPC customers, we must not attempt to create public short links. UI should detect environment and show only "Copy permalink (internal)" or disable short link option with tooltip explaining restrictions.

devon: Good call. Analytics should have a prop trigger_env: hosted|dedicated|private. For private, trace.copy_method should only be full_id or internal_permalink. No external short tokens.

mika: Focus management: when menu opens, put focus on first menuitem. Support ArrowDown/ArrowUp navigation, Enter to activate, Esc to close and return focus to trigger. Ensure keyboard users can use Space/Enter equivalently.

nora: Failure mode: if clipboard API is blocked, show a small inline fallback that selects the value for manual copy and a dismissible banner: "Clipboard blocked. Press Ctrl/C to copy." Make sure the fallback is reachable by keyboard.

ashe: For permalink creation failures (rate limit or shortener down) show toast: "Could not generate short link. Copied full permalink instead." Use aria-live=polite for toasts. Keep copy UX local-only where possible to reduce latency.

devon: Also capture copy success/failure events: trace.copy_result (props: method, success:true|false, error_code:clipboard_blocked|shortener_error). No full ids in events.

mika: Color/contrast: ensure chevron + menu meet 4.5:1 on normal text or use larger target sizes. Provide 44x44px tap targets on mobile and visible focus ring 3px minimum.

nora: Microcopy decisions: label visible trigger as "Copy" (compact). aria-label="Copy: open menu for ID and permalink options". Menu items: "Copy correlation ID" and "Copy permalink (short)" or "Copy permalink (internal)" depending on env.

ashe: For discoverability, add a tiny persistent hint in the detail header: "Tip: press C when correlation ID selected to copy". But only show on first visit and allow dismiss.

devon: Instrumentation note: track which UI surfaced the action (inline control vs header vs kebab) as ui_source prop, and selected_count if bulk.

mika: A11y-bot: creating tickets D-5001 (Split copy control + keyboard menu), D-5002 (Permalink env detection + fallback), D-5003 (Clipboard fallback overlay + toasts).

nora: Action items: nora update Figma with combined control + env variants by Tue; ashe prototype server-side shortener fallback copy flow by Thu; devon write analytics spec masking rules by Wed; mika add accessibility checklist and test cases by Wed.
a11y-bot: Tasks created and linked to board: UX-5001, UX-5002 :rocket:

nora: Thanks team. I'll post prototype links and GIFs when ready. Closing thread for now.
